capabilities: Open and edit markdown files anywhere on disk via symlinks that write through to the original
Create new files with a native file picker or by typing an absolute path
Toggle a focus mode that hides the ribbon, sidebars, tab bar, and status bar
Clean up links whose original file was deleted or moved
disambiguation: Not a bulk file manager or importer; it links one file at a time on demand when you run its commands.
extras: Desktop-only (isDesktopOnly: true); files in protected locations like ~/Documents on macOS require granting Obsidian Full Disk Access. Vault sync services (iCloud, Obsidian Sync, Dropbox) will not carry the symlink links to other devices. Community-plugin listing notes it has not been manually reviewed; the author asks for Ko-fi donations.
problem: Obsidian only edits files inside the vault, so working on markdown files elsewhere on disk means copying them and keeping duplicates in sync.
summary: Edits any markdown file on your machine from inside a vault by creating a symlink to the original, with a distraction-free focus mode.
